title: The Hidden Hand — Access to the People in Power
subtitle: Named gatekeepers, institutional continuity, dynastic principals and testable models of concealed influence
editorialBoundary: This dataset names people whose published offices give them access to principals, agendas, appointments, sensitive information, boards or implementation systems. Inclusion does not establish criminality, blackmail, secret-society membership, ritual practice or control of the person they advise. Documented roles, structural assessments, disputed hypotheses, unsupported claims and symbolic interpretations are displayed separately.

methodology.principle: Name the person, identify the access mechanism, cite the record, state the constraint and specify what evidence would be needed to prove a stronger claim.
methodology.rankMeaning: The intermediary access score estimates current documented proximity and operational reach. It is not a moral ranking and does not claim secret rulership.

updatePolicy.publicationRule: Automated checks may flag a role or source for review but may not silently upgrade a claim, invent a replacement or publish a sensitive allegation.
updatePolicy.historyRule: Preserve the previous dated file whenever a reviewed profile, score, role or classification changes.
